name: Ascension
overview: The topic of Ascension in Scripture includes the remarkable account of Elijah being taken up into heaven by a whirlwind, as recorded in 2 Kings 2:1-6. Elijah's departure is accompanied by his faithful companion Elisha, who refuses to leave him despite Elijah's instructions to stay behind at various locations. This narrative demonstrates God's sovereign power in removing His servant from the earthly realm, affirming divine authority and the continuation of prophetic ministry through Elisha.
